name: runlog-monorepo
description: An engine for dice-driven challenge and creative-practice games: a twist on a stream, a constraint in the studio, a log that remembers.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/container/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/rules-schema/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/engine/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/deck-profiles/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/themes/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/session/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/cli/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p hosted/infra/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p streamdeck/tsconfig.json
scripts.check:stage: node --experimental-strip-types scripts/stage.ts 0.0.0-check && node packages/cli/stage/dist/runlog.js validate packs/demo/pack.yaml --strict && node -e "import('./packages/cli/stage/dist/index.js').then(m => { if (typeof m.seal !== 'function') throw new Error('no seal export') })"
